inputs.style: Crushing Brazilian groove metal, very low distorted guitar riffs, primal floor-tom polyrhythms, powerful bass, raw guttural male English vocal, gang shouts. 104 BPM, C minor. a low stomping syncopated guitar hook, original percussion-only tension break, enormous riff return. Raw heavily overdriven rhythm guitar amplifiers, forceful male English vocals. Complete 280-330 second song, extended developed guitar solo, riff variations, final chorus and decisive heavy ending.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Concrete swallows the river’s tongue
We built a wall where the ancestors sung
The water rises, cold and thick
Burying the map, burying the ditch
They say the flood is clean, they say it’s new
But the mud knows the faces we knew

[Chorus]
Stone remembers! Stone remembers!
Feet in the clay, the valley trembles
Stone remembers! Stone remembers!
Blood in the bedrock, the silence tembles

[Verse]
Valve turns slow, the pressure climbs
Drowning the names, drowning the times
The old men walk on the submerged floor
With roots for legs and stone for core
They don’t scream, they just stand in the deep
Waking the giants from their sleep

[Chorus]
Stone remembers! Stone remembers!
Feet in the clay, the valley trembles
Stone remembers! Stone remembers!
Blood in the bedrock, the silence tembles

[Verse]
The pressure cracks the concrete spine
The water rushes through the line
But the stone beneath begins to grind
With the sound of a thousand minds
They don’t flow, they march in rows
With muddy feet and silent throes
The valley drains into the deep
But the giants rise from under the sleep
They wear the river as a shroud
With the history of the drowned in the crowd
The dam holds back the sea of bone
Stone remembers what the flesh has shown

[Bridge]
(Percussion only)
Tom-tom... Tom-tom... Tom-tom... Tom-tom...
Silence...
(Explosion of riffs)
CRUSH!

[Solo]
(Distorted guitar solo)

[Chorus]
Stone remembers! Stone remembers!
Feet in the clay, the valley trembles
Stone remembers! Stone remembers!
Blood in the bedrock, the silence tembles

[Outro]
The dam breaks... The dam breaks...
Stone remembers... The dam breaks...
